words.ex: The wound caused a serious infection.
words.ex_cn: 伤口引起了严重的感染。
words.en: An infection is a disease caused by microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, or parasites invading the body.

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.tr: phrase. 久而久之；随着时间的过去
words.ex: He gets better over time.
words.ex_cn: 他随着时间的推移变得更好。
words.en: If something happens over time, it happens gradually during a long period.

words.ex: The old woman predict rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 那位老妇人预言明天会下雨。
words.en: If you predict an event, you say that it will happen.

words.ex: He has finished his homework by now.
words.ex_cn: 到目前为止，他已经完成了作业。
words.en: Up to the present moment; at this time.

words.ex: He does well in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上表现很好。
words.en: To perform well or successfully in a particular activity or task.

words.tr:
n. 人们；人民；
adj. 民间的；
words.ex: The folk in the village are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 村子里的人们非常友好。
words.en: Folk can refer to people in general, or to a particular group of people. It can also refer to traditional music or customs of a community.

words.tr:
n. 钩；挂钩；
v. 钩住；
words.ex: The key hung on a metal hook.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙挂在金属钩上。
words.en: A hook is a bent piece of metal or plastic that is used for catching or holding things, or for hanging things on.

words.tr:
n. 挑战；
v. 提出挑战；
words.ex: Climbing that mountain is a big challenge.
words.ex_cn: 爬那座山是一个巨大的挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.tr: 短语. ……怎么样；……好吗（用于提出建议或征求对方意见）
words.ex: How about we go to the park?
words.ex_cn: 我们去公园怎么样？
words.en: used to make a suggestion or to ask for someone's opinion

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.ex: He strengthened his muscle by lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他通过举重来增强肌肉。
words.en: Muscle is the tissue in the body that can contract to produce movement or maintain the position of parts of the body.

words.ex: He will take over the business next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将接管这家企业。
words.en: To take control of something, especially a company, by buying a majority of its shares or by getting a position of power within it.

words.ex: He did not show up for class yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没有来上课。
words.en: If someone shows up, they arrive somewhere, especially unexpectedly or after they have been waiting a long time.

words.ex: I feel sympathy for the poor children.
words.ex_cn: 我对那些可怜的孩子感到同情。
words.en: If you have sympathy for someone who is in a bad situation, you are sorry for them, and show this in the way you behave towards them.

words.ex: He walked all the way to school.
words.ex_cn: 他一路走到学校。
words.en: From the beginning to the end; completely.

words.tr: phrase. 苏醒过来；变得活跃；显得逼真
words.ex: The painting seems to come to life in the moonlight.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画在月光下似乎活了过来。
words.en: To become active or lively; to start to function or operate.

words.ex: He uses software to write his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他使用软件写作业。
words.en: Software refers to the programs and other operating information used by a computer.

words.tr:
n. 屏幕；屏风；掩蔽物；
v. 筛查；掩蔽；
words.ex: The movie is playing on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 电影正在屏幕上播放。
words.en: A screen is a flat surface on which pictures or words are shown, such as the one on a television or computer. It can also refer to a partition used to divide or protect an area. As a verb, to screen means to examine something in order to decide whether it is suitable for a particular purpose, or to protect someone or something from something harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: The chart is visually easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这个图表在视觉上很容易理解。
words.en: In a way that relates to seeing or sight.

words.ex: Children show great creativity when drawing pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在画画时表现出很强的创造力。
words.en: Creativity is the ability to use your imagination to produce new ideas, make things, or think of new solutions to problems.

words.ex: The corporate office is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的总部在纽约。
words.en: Corporate relates to large companies or to a particular large company.

words.ex: He is learning elementary math at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习初级数学。
words.en: Elementary means relating to the simplest and most basic aspects of a subject.

words.ex: His motivation is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助他人。
words.en: Motivation is the enthusiasm or reason for doing something.

words.ex: I believe in working hard to achieve my dreams.
words.ex_cn: 我相信努力工作能实现我的梦想。
words.en: To feel certain that something exists or is true, or to have confidence in a person or thing.

words.tr: phrase. 非常重视；热衷于；大力支持（某事物）
words.ex: He is big on exercise every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他非常重视每天早上锻炼。
words.en: To be very interested in or enthusiastic about something.

words.tr:
v. 追逐；
n. 追逐；
words.ex: The dog chases the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗每天早上追逐猫。
words.en: To chase someone or something means to quickly follow them or it in order to catch them.

words.tr: phrase. 为什么不（用于提出建议或表示同意）
words.ex: Why not go for a walk?
words.ex_cn: 为什么不去散个步呢？
words.en: used to make a suggestion or to agree with a suggestion

words.ex: The janitor cleans the school every night.
words.ex_cn: 门卫每天晚上打扫学校。
words.en: A janitor is a person whose job is to take care of a building, especially by cleaning it.

words.tr: n. 追赶者；追寻者；追捕者
words.ex: The pursuer was relentless in his chase.
words.ex_cn: 追捕者对他的追逐毫不松懈。
words.en: A pursuer is someone who is following or chasing someone else, often in order to catch them.

words.ex: The refugee walked to a new country.
words.ex_cn: 这名难民步行去了一个新国家。
words.en: A refugee is a person who has been forced to leave their country in order to escape war, persecution, or natural disaster.

words.tr: n. 古希腊、古罗马文学（classic 的复数）
words.ex: He loves reading classics like Homer and Plato.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读荷马和柏拉图这样的经典作品。
words.en: Classics refers to the study of the literature, history, and culture of ancient Greece and Rome, or the works of literature and art that are considered to be of the highest quality and of lasting importance.

words.ex: The philosopher wrote a book about life.
words.ex_cn: 这位哲学家写了一本关于生活的书。
words.en: A philosopher is a person who studies or writes about philosophy.

words.ex: He became famous for his music and gained great fame.
words.ex_cn: 他因音乐而闻名，获得了巨大的名声。
words.en: the state of being known or talked about by many people, especially on account of notable achievements

words.tr:
n. 转移；移位；转变；轮班；
v. 变换位置；转移；换（挡）；轮班；
words.ex: The shift of power to the new government was sudden.
words.ex_cn: 权力向新政府的转移是突然的。
words.en: If you shift something or if it shifts, it moves or changes its position slightly. If someone's opinion, attitude, or behaviour shifts, it changes slightly, especially in response to a particular situation or event.

words.tr: phrase. 熬夜通宵学习或工作
words.ex: He pulled an all-nighter to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他通宵达旦地完成了作业。
words.en: To stay up all night, especially to work or study.

words.ex: He receives honors for his excellent grades.
words.ex_cn: 他因优异的成绩获得荣誉。
words.en: High respect; great esteem. A privilege. A course of degree studies more specialized than for an ordinary pass.

words.tr:
n. 结果；
v. 导致；
words.ex: The result of the test was good.
words.ex_cn: 这次测试的结果很好。
words.en: A consequence, outcome, or effect of an action or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 跑进；撞上；偶遇；陷入；达到
words.ex: The dog ran into the house.
words.ex_cn: 狗跑进了房子。
words.en: To meet someone or find something by chance; to experience something unexpectedly; to collide with something.

words.ex: He walks to class on campus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行到校园上课。
words.en: The grounds and buildings of a university or college.

words.tr: n. （表示赞成或满意）翘拇指
words.ex: He gave me a thumbs-up when I finished the race.
words.ex_cn: 我跑完比赛后，他对我竖起了大拇指。
words.en: A thumbs-up is a gesture in which you hold your hand out with your thumb pointing upwards in order to show approval of something.

words.ex: He stood on the podium to receive the gold medal.
words.ex_cn: 他站在领奖台上领取金牌。
words.en: A podium is a small platform on which someone stands to give a speech or conduct an orchestra, or on which a medal winner stands during a prize-giving ceremony.

words.ex: The judge will preside over the trial tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 法官明天将主持审判。
words.en: To preside over a meeting or event means to be in charge of it and to ensure that it is conducted in an orderly and efficient manner.

words.ex: The wedding ceremony was beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼仪式很美丽。
words.en: A ceremony is a formal event held on special occasions such as weddings, graduations, or official functions, often involving traditional or religious rituals.

words.ex: He received a certificate for completing the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了课程后获得了证书。
words.en: A certificate is an official document attesting a fact, in particular.

words.tr: n. 学者；[复数]（院校的）学术活动；学者( academic的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The academics published a new research paper.
words.ex_cn: 这些学者发表了一篇新的研究论文。
words.en: Academics refers to the scholarly activities of a school or educational institution, especially the pursuit of research, education, and scholarship.

words.ex: I am grateful for your help.
words.ex_cn: 我感激你的帮助。
words.en: If you are grateful for something that someone has given you or done for you, you have warm, friendly feelings towards them and wish to thank them.

words.ex: He will flee from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 他会从着火的房子里逃走。
words.en: If you flee from something or someone, you leave them quickly because you are afraid of them or because you do not want to be involved with them.

words.tr: adj. 专注的；专用的；献身的； v. 奉献；“dedicate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is dedicated to his studies.
words.ex_cn: 他专注于学习。
words.en: If you say that someone is dedicated to something, you approve of the fact that they have committed to it and are willing to give a lot of time and energy to it.

words.ex: He returned to his homeland after many years.
words.ex_cn: 多年后，他回到了祖国。
words.en: Your homeland is your native country.

words.tr: n. （美）餐馆工（等于 bus boy）
words.ex: The busboy clears the tables after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 洗碗工在晚饭后清理桌子。
words.en: A busboy is a person who works in a restaurant or cafeteria, doing tasks such as clearing tables and assisting the waiters and waitresses.

words.ex: He uses his cellphone to call his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他用手机给妈妈打电话。
words.en: A cellphone is a telephone that does not have wires and works by radio, that you can carry with you and use anywhere.

words.tr:
n. 面试；访谈；
v. 面试；接见；
words.ex: He has an interview tomorrow for a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他明天有一场新工作的面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study.

words.ex: The coffee had a strong bitterness.
words.ex_cn: 这杯咖啡有很重的苦味。
words.en: Bitterness is the quality of having a sharp, pungent taste or of feeling angry and unhappy because of bad experiences.

words.tr:
v. 遭遇；遇到；邂逅；
n. 遭遇；
words.ex: He encountered a bear while hiking in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林里徒步时遭遇了一只熊。
words.en: If you encounter problems or difficulties, you experience them.

words.ex: His ambition is to become a president.
words.ex_cn: 他的野心是成为总统。
words.en: An ambition is a strong desire to achieve something, typically requiring determination and hard work.

words.tr: abbr. 哲学博士学位；博士学位；“Doctor of Philosophy”的缩写
words.ex: She earned her Ph.D. in quantum physics.
words.ex_cn: 她获得了量子物理学博士学位。
words.en: A Ph.D. is the highest academic degree awarded by universities in most fields of study.

words.ex: The supervisor checked the workers' progress.
words.ex_cn: 主管检查了工人们的进展。
words.en: A supervisor is a person who oversees and directs the work of others.

words.tr: n. 管理人；保管人；监护人
words.ex: The custodian takes care of the school building.
words.ex_cn: 管理人负责照顾学校大楼。
words.en: A custodian is someone who is responsible for looking after or protecting something valuable or important.

words.tr: adj. 勇猛的； v. “spirit”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The spirited dog chased the ball without fear.
words.ex_cn: 这只勇猛的狗毫不畏惧地追着球。
words.en: Someone who is spirited is full of energy, courage, and determination.

words.ex: His determination helped him finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他的决心帮助他完成了比赛。
words.en: Determination is the quality that you show when you have decided to do something and you will not let anything stop you.

words.tr: n. 先见；预见；先见之明
words.ex: He showed foresight by saving money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 他通过为未来存钱展现了远见。
words.en: The ability to predict or the action of predicting what will happen or be needed in the future.

words.tr:
n. 影响（力）；
v. 影响；
words.ex: The teacher had a big influence on her students.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生们有很大的影响。
words.en: The power to affect, control, or manipulate someone or something.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built pyramids for their kings.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人为他们的国王建造了金字塔。
words.en: A pyramid is a monumental structure with a square or triangular base and sloping sides that meet in a point at the top, especially one built of stone as a royal tomb in ancient Egypt.

words.ex: They will dismantle the old bridge next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周将拆除这座旧桥。
words.en: To dismantle something means to take it to pieces.

words.tr:
v. 领会；抓紧；
n. 领会；
words.ex: I couldn't grasp the meaning of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 我没能领会这首诗的含义。
words.en: To grasp something means to take it in your hand and hold it firmly.

words.ex: He got an opportunity to work abroad.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了一个去国外工作的机会。
words.en: An opportunity is a situation in which it is possible for you to do something that you want to do.

words.ex: He obtained a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周获得了一份新工作。
words.en: If you obtain something, you get it or achieve it.

words.ex: He needs a visa to travel to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他需要一张签证去日本旅行。
words.en: A visa is an official document, or a stamp put in your passport, which allows you to enter or leave a particular country.

words.ex: He worked hard to fulfill his dream.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现自己的梦想。
words.en: To fulfill a task, role, or function means to do or perform it as required or expected.

words.ex: He decided to quit smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年决定戒烟。
words.en: If you quit, or quit something, you stop doing it or leave it.

words.tr: adj. 东方的（尤指中国和日本）
words.ex: He bought an oriental rug at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一张东方地毯。
words.en: Oriental is used to describe things that come from or are associated with eastern Asia, especially China and Japan.

words.tr:
n. 表；名单；
v. 列出；
words.ex: He wrote his name on the list.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己的名字写在了表上。
words.en: A list is a set of items, especially names, written or printed one after the other.

words.tr: phrase. 证券交易所；证券交易
words.ex: He buys stocks on the stock exchange.
words.ex_cn: 他在证券交易所购买股票。
words.en: A stock exchange is a place where people buy and sell shares in companies.

words.tr: 短语动词. 破产；倒闭
words.ex: He went bankrupt after the business failed.
words.ex_cn: 他的生意失败后破产了。
words.en: To go bankrupt means to become unable to pay one's debts and thus to have one's financial affairs administered under the bankruptcy laws.

words.tr:
n. 利润；
v. 获利；
words.ex: The company made a big profit this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年赚了大量利润。
words.en: Profit is the amount of money that you gain when you are paid more for something than it cost you to make, get, or do it.

words.tr: phrase. 起起落落；盛衰；浮沉；人生的高低起伏
words.ex: Life has ups and downs, but she stays happy.
words.ex_cn: 生活有起有落，但她一直很快乐。
words.en: The phrase 'ups and downs' refers to the alternating periods of good and bad fortune or success and failure that someone or something experiences.

words.ex: He built a successful career in medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他在医学领域建立了成功的事业。
words.en: A career is the job or series of jobs that you do during your working life, especially if you continue to get better jobs and earn more money.

words.tr: phrase. 重新开始；从头再来
words.ex: He decides to start over after failing the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试失败后决定从头再来。
words.en: To begin again or anew.

words.tr: phrase. 经历；仔细检查；完成；通过；穿过
words.ex: He went through a hard time last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一段艰难的时光。
words.en: To experience something, often something difficult or unpleasant, or to examine or discuss something in detail.

words.ex: He faced many hardships during the war.
words.ex_cn: 他在战争期间经历了许多困苦。
words.en: Hardship refers to a situation that is difficult to endure because of lack of money, resources, or other basic necessities.

words.tr: n. 严酷的考验；痛苦的经历；煎熬
words.ex: He went through a long ordeal before he found peace.
words.ex_cn: 他在找到平静之前经历了一段漫长的磨难。
words.en: An ordeal is a very unpleasant and prolonged experience.

words.tr:
n. 珍宝；宝物；财富；
v. 珍惜；
words.ex: The old map showed where the treasure was buried.
words.ex_cn: 那张旧地图显示了珍宝埋藏的地方。
words.en: If you treasure something that you have, you keep it or care for it carefully because it gives you great pleasure and you think it is very special.

words.ex: Drugs can relieve pain.
words.ex_cn: 药物可以减轻疼痛。
words.en: To relieve someone or something means to make a problem, pain, or unpleasant feeling less severe or to take it away completely.

words.tr: n. 紧张；紧张局势；紧张关系；
words.ex: There was tension between the two friends after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 两人争吵后，彼此之间出现了紧张。
words.en: Tension is a feeling of worry and anxiety which makes it difficult for you to relax. It can also refer to the state of being stretched tight or the degree of tightness of a stretched string, wire, etc.

words.ex: The travelers found an oasis with water and trees.
words.ex_cn: 旅行者们发现了一个有水和树木的绿洲。
words.en: An oasis is a small area in a desert where water and plants are found, making it a place of relief and beauty in an otherwise barren landscape.

words.ex: His perseverance helped him finish the marathon.
words.ex_cn: 他的毅力帮助他完成了马拉松。
words.en: Perseverance is the quality of continuing to try to achieve a particular aim despite difficulties.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 拖着；带着；紧随其后；被牵引着
words.ex: The car was pulling a broken bike in tow.
words.ex_cn: 那辆车拖着一辆坏掉的自行车。
words.en: If you have someone in tow, they are following you closely because you are looking after them or you are responsible for them.

words.w: one's thoughts go out to sb.
words.tr: phrase. 心系某人；惦念某人；对某人深表同情
words.uk: wʌnz θɔːts ɡəʊ aʊt tə ˈsʌmbɒdi
words.us: wʌnz θɔts ɡoʊ aʊt tə ˈsʌmbɑdi
words.ex: Her thoughts go out to the lost children.
words.ex_cn: 她的思绪牵挂着那些失踪的孩子。
words.en: To express concern or sympathy for someone.

words.w: one's heart goes out to sb.
words.tr: phrase. 对某人深表同情；为某人感到难过
words.uk: wʌnz hɑːt ɡəʊz aʊt tə ˈsʌmbədi
words.us: wʌnz hɑːrt ɡoʊz aʊt tə ˈsʌmbədi
words.ex: My heart goes out to the family after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，我为那个家庭感到难过。
words.en: If your heart goes out to someone who is in trouble, you feel sympathy for them.

words.tr: n. 记录员；登记员；教务主任
words.ex: The registrar gave me my schedule.
words.ex_cn: 注册处给我发了课表。
words.en: A registrar is an official keeper of records, especially in an educational institution, who is responsible for student records and registration.

words.ex: He will take charge of the project next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将负责这个项目。
words.en: To assume control or responsibility for something.

words.tr: phrase. 成一直线；一致；协调；有秩序
words.ex: The books are placed in line on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书整齐地排成一条直线放在书架上。
words.en: If people or things are in line, they are arranged in a line or a row.

words.tr: phrase. 排队站立；按顺序等候
words.ex: He stands in line for coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上排队买咖啡。
words.en: To wait in a queue, one behind the other, often for something such as tickets or entry.

words.tr: v. 反映；反射；反省；思考；仔细考虑；
words.ex: The mirror reflects the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 镜子反射阳光。
words.en: If a surface reflects light, heat, sound, or an image, it sends the light, etc. back and does not absorb it. If something is reflected in a mirror or in water, you can see its image in the mirror or in the water.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细想；考虑；反思；带来不良影响
words.ex: He likes to reflect on his day before sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在睡觉前反思自己的一天。
words.en: If you reflect on something, you think deeply about it.

words.tr: n. 沉思；反射；反映；反省；
words.ex: He sat quietly in the garden for reflection.
words.ex_cn: 他静静地坐在花园里沉思。
words.en: A reflection is an image that you can see in a mirror, glass, or water.

words.tr: phrase. 如果不；否则；要是不；即使不
words.ex: Hurry up, if not you will miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 快点，如果不的话你会错过公交车。
words.en: Used to introduce a condition that must be met for the main clause to occur; otherwise, the main clause does not occur.

words.ex: The faculty of engineering has many labs.
words.ex_cn: 工程学院有许多实验室。
words.en: A faculty is a group of departments in a university or college that specialize in a particular subject or group of subjects, or the teachers in such a group.

words.ex: It was raining, nonetheless, we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 天下着雨，尽管如此，我们还是去散步了。
words.en: Nonetheless is used to indicate that something is true or happens in spite of what has just been said.

words.ex: He is an undergraduate at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
words.en: An undergraduate is a student at a university or college who is studying for their first degree.

words.ex: She combines flour and water to make dough.
words.ex_cn: 她把面粉和水混合在一起做面团。
words.en: To combine means to join or merge two or more things together to form a single entity.

words.tr: adj. 不可避免的；必定的；
words.ex: It is inevitable that the sun will rise tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳明天一定会升起。
words.en: If something is inevitable, it is certain to happen and cannot be prevented or avoided.

words.tr: adj. 尴尬的；窘迫的； v. “embarrass”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt embarrassed when he tripped in front of everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在大家面前绊倒时感到很尴尬。
words.en: If you are embarrassed, you feel shy or ashamed because of something that you have done or that has happened to you.

words.ex: The music accompanies the dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐伴随舞蹈。
words.en: To go somewhere with someone as a companion or escort; to play a musical accompaniment for.

words.ex: He will pass the test, no doubt.
words.ex_cn: 他肯定会通过考试。
words.en: You use no doubt to indicate that you are making a judgment or statement that you think is probably true, although you are not certain.

words.ex: He will misguide you with wrong advice.
words.ex_cn: 他会用错误的建议误导你。
words.en: If you are misguided by someone or something, you are led to believe something that is not true or to do something that is wrong or not suitable.

words.ex: He remembers his boyhood in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他记得自己在乡村的童年时光。
words.en: Boyhood is the period of a male person's life during which he is a boy.

words.ex: He crushed the can with his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他用手把罐子压碎了。
words.en: To crush something means to press it very hard so that its shape is destroyed or so that it breaks into pieces. It can also mean to defeat someone completely, or to make someone feel extremely upset or disappointed.

words.ex: He attended a seminar on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a problem or topic.

words.ex: He complains about the loud noise every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都抱怨噪音太大。
words.en: To express dissatisfaction, pain, or resentment, usually because of a particular situation or someone's actions.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.tr:
n. 问题；重要议题；发行（物）；
v. 发行；
words.ex: The main issue is lack of money.
words.ex_cn: 主要问题是缺乏资金。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are talking about or arguing about.

words.tr: phrase. 放手；松开；释放；放弃
words.ex: He decided to let go of the old toy.
words.ex_cn: 他决定放开那个旧玩具。
words.en: To release one's hold on something or someone; to allow someone or something to leave or be free.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 难以置信地；带着怀疑地
words.ex: He stared at the score in disbelief.
words.ex_cn: 他难以置信地盯着分数。
words.en: Expressing shock or doubt, unable to believe what one is seeing or hearing.

words.tr:
n. 成人；
adj. 成年的；
words.ex: An adult must pay taxes.
words.ex_cn: 成人必须缴税。
words.en: An adult is a mature, fully developed person. An adult has reached the age when they are legally responsible for their actions.

words.ex: He is aware of the danger.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到危险。
words.en: If you are aware of something, you know about it.

words.tr: phrase. 勉强应付；混过去；胡乱对付过去
words.ex: He muddled through the math test without studying.
words.ex_cn: 他没复习就勉强通过了数学考试。
words.en: If you muddle through, you manage to do something even though you do not have the proper equipment or do not really know how to do it.

words.ex: The bank gave a loan to the student.
words.ex_cn: 银行向学生提供了一笔贷款。
words.en: A loan is a sum of money that you borrow.

words.tr: phrase. 找到自己的路；设法到达某处
words.ex: The lost dog found its way home.
words.ex_cn: 那只迷路的狗找到了回家的路。
words.en: To discover the correct route or method to reach a destination or achieve a goal.

words.ex: The hikers faced great peril in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者在风暴中面临巨大危险。
words.en: Peril refers to serious and immediate danger.

words.tr: adj. 关心的；有同情心的；
words.ex: She is a caring teacher who helps her students.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位关心学生的老师。
words.en: If someone is caring, they are affectionate, helpful, and sympathetic.

words.ex: He has never set foot in that building.
words.ex_cn: 他从未踏入过那栋大楼。
words.en: To enter or go into a place.

words.tr: adj. 支持的；支援的；给予帮助的；
words.ex: My parents are supportive when I study hard.
words.ex_cn: 当我努力学习时，我的父母总是支持我。
words.en: If you are supportive, you are kind and helpful to someone at a difficult or unhappy time in their life.

words.ex: The accident was a serious incident.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是一起严重事件。
words.en: An incident is an event that is either unpleasant or unusual.

words.tr: v. 恳求；辩护；答辩；以…为理由
words.ex: He pleaded for help when he was lost.
words.ex_cn: 当他迷路时，他恳求帮助。
words.en: If you plead with someone to do something, you ask them in an intense, emotional way to do it.

words.ex: Stay put until I come back.
words.ex_cn: 我回来之前原地待着。
words.en: To remain in one place and not move.

words.ex: They will negotiate the price with the seller.
words.ex_cn: 他们会与卖家协商价格。
words.en: If people negotiate with each other or negotiate an agreement, they talk about a problem or a situation such as a business arrangement in order to solve the problem or complete the arrangement.

words.ex_cn: 他关心他的成绩。
words.en: If you are concerned with something, you are giving it your attention because you think it is important or because you are worried about it.

words.ex: He won a scholarship to study at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一项去哈佛学习的奖学金。
words.en: A scholarship is a grant or payment made to support a student's education, awarded on the basis of academic or other achievement.

words.ex: He will undertake a new project next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将从事一个新项目。
words.en: To undertake a task or job means to start doing it and accept responsibility for it.

words.tr: v. 从事；承担；“undertake”的过去分词；
words.ex: He undertook a new job last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月从事了一份新工作。
words.en: If you undertake a task or a responsibility, you start doing it and accept responsibility for it.

words.tr: phrase. 要紧；区别对待；有影响；起（重要）作用
words.ex: Volunteering can make a difference in your community.
words.ex_cn: 志愿服务能为你的社区带来改变。
words.en: If something makes a difference, it affects someone or something positively, especially in a noticeable or important way.

words.tr: phrase. 减少；落下；睡着；让...下车
words.ex: The number of students dropped off last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年学生人数减少了。
words.en: If the level, amount, or value of something drops off, it becomes less.

words.ex: He is a freshman at university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的一名新生。
words.en: A freshman is a student in the first year of high school, college, or university.

words.ex: He showed strong emotion when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，表现出了强烈的情绪。
words.en: An emotion is a feeling such as happiness, love, fear, anger, or hatred, which can be caused by the situation that you are in or the people you are with.

words.ex: I am awaiting the bus.
words.ex_cn: 我正在等公交车。
words.en: If you await someone or something, you wait for them.

words.ex: The country gained independence in 1960.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在1960年获得了独立。
words.en: Independence is the freedom from control or influence of others, allowing one to make decisions and act on one's own.

words.tr: phrase. 文科；人文科学（包括语言、哲学、历史、文学、艺术等学科）
words.ex: He majors in liberal arts at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修文科。
words.en: The liberal arts are academic subjects such as history, literature, and languages, as distinct from professional and technical subjects.

words.tr: phrase. 文理学院；以本科通识教育为主、侧重人文与科学的小型高等院校
words.ex: He attends a liberal arts college to study literature and history.
words.ex_cn: 他上一所文理学院学习文学和历史。
words.en: A liberal arts college is a college with an emphasis on undergraduate study in the liberal arts and sciences. Such colleges aim to impart a broad general knowledge and develop general intellectual capacities, in contrast to a professional, vocational, or technical curriculum.

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的表现非常出色。
words.en: The act of performing a play, concert, or some other form of entertainment.

words.ex: He made a commitment to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺按时完成这个项目。
words.en: A commitment is something that regularly takes up some of your time because of an agreement you have made or because of responsibilities that you have.

words.tr: phrase. 发射台：用于发射火箭或导弹的平台。
words.ex: The rocket sits on the launching pad.
words.ex_cn: 火箭停在发射台上。
words.en: A launching pad is a platform from which a rocket or missile is launched, or a situation that provides a good opportunity for someone or something to start or develop.

words.ex: I cannot help but smile when I see my dog.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到我的狗时，我忍不住微笑。
words.en: If you say that you cannot help doing something, you mean that you cannot prevent yourself from doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 贮藏着；准备着；保存着
words.ex: There is a surprise in store for you.
words.ex_cn: 为你准备了一个惊喜。
words.en: If something is in store for you, it is going to happen to you in the future.

words.ex: He is about to leave the house.
words.ex_cn: 他马上就要离开家了。
words.en: If you are about to do something, you are going to do it very soon.

words.ex: She took a glance at the clock.
words.ex_cn: 她瞥了一眼钟。
words.en: If you glance at something or someone, you look at them very quickly and then look away again immediately.

words.tr: phrase. 停止运转；出故障；分解；感情失控
words.ex: The machine broke down yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器昨天坏了。
words.en: If a machine or vehicle breaks down, it stops working. If a discussion, relationship, or system breaks down, it fails because of a problem or disagreement.

words.ex: The magnitude of this decision will affect everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定的重要性会影响每个人。
words.en: Magnitude refers to the great size or extent of something, or the importance of something.

words.ex: The doctor said the patient needs urgent care.
words.ex_cn: 医生说病人需要紧急治疗。
words.en: If something is urgent, it needs to be dealt with as soon as possible.

words.ex: Humankind needs to protect the Earth.
words.ex_cn: 人类需要保护地球。
words.en: Humankind refers to all human beings collectively; the human race.

words.tr: v. 兴旺；繁荣；茁壮成长；
words.ex: Plants thrive in sunny places.
words.ex_cn: 植物在阳光充足的地方茁壮成长。
words.en: To thrive means to grow or develop well or vigorously.

words.tr: phrase. v. 度过难关；勉强应付；勉强维持生活
words.ex: He gets by with little money.
words.ex_cn: 他靠很少的钱维持生活。
words.en: To manage to live or do a particular thing using the money, knowledge, equipment, etc. that you have.

words.ex: He used a torch to find his keys in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他用手电筒在黑暗中找钥匙。
words.en: A torch is a stick with a flame on one end that is used as a source of light, or a portable battery-powered electric lamp.

words.tr: adj. 教育性的；有启发的；有益的
words.ex: The movie is instructive for children.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影对孩子们很有教育意义。
words.en: Providing useful or interesting information or knowledge.

words.ex: Children have a strong imagination.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们有很强的想象力。
words.en: The ability to form pictures or ideas in your mind of things that are new and exciting, or not real.

words.ex: He finally embraced the new idea.
words.ex_cn: 他最终接受了这个新想法。
words.en: To take someone into your arms as a sign of love or affection, or to accept something enthusiastically.

words.ex: The police opened an inquiry into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An inquiry is a question which you ask in order to get some information.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.ex: She is self-assured when she speaks in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 她在全班面前讲话时很自信。
words.en: Someone who is self-assured shows confidence in what they say and do because they are sure of their own abilities.

words.ex: He is self-aware and knows his strengths.
words.ex_cn: 他很有自知之明，知道自己的优点。
words.en: Someone who is self-aware knows and judges their own character well.

words.ex: He felt an obligation to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他感到有义务帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An obligation is something that you must do because you have promised, because of a law, etc.

words.tr: n. 平均成绩点；平均绩点
words.ex: He has a high gpa because he studies hard.
words.ex_cn: 他因为努力学习而有很高的GPA。
words.en: A GPA is a measure of a student's academic achievement at a college or university, calculated by averaging the grades obtained in all courses.

words.ex: He has a passion for painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画充满激情。
words.en: A very strong feeling of love, hate, anger, enthusiasm, etc.

words.ex: Honesty is important in friendship.
words.ex_cn: 诚实在友谊中很重要。
words.en: The quality of being honest, which involves being truthful, sincere, and free from deceit or fraud.

words.tr:
n. 事情；物质；
v. 要紧；
words.ex: What's the matter with you?
words.ex_cn: 你怎么了？
words.en: Matter is a physical substance in general, as distinct from mind and spirit; (in physics) that which occupies space and possesses rest mass, especially as distinct from energy. It can also refer to a subject or situation under consideration.

words.tr: phrase. 独自行动；单干；不依赖他人
words.ex: He decided to go it alone and start his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他决定独自一人创业。
words.en: To do something without help from anyone else.

words.tr: phrase. 着眼于；考虑到；为了
words.ex: He saves money with an eye to buying a car.
words.ex_cn: 他存钱是为了买一辆车。
words.en: If you do something with an eye to something else, you do it with the intention of achieving that other thing.

words.ex: Social problems affect many families.
words.ex_cn: 社会问题影响许多家庭。
words.en: Social means relating to society or to the way society is organized.

words.ex: He will enroll in the English course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将注册英语课程。
words.en: To officially register or enlist oneself or someone else in a course, institution, or organization.

words.ex: Follow the procedure step by step.
words.ex_cn: 一步一步地按照步骤进行。
words.en: A procedure is a way of doing something, especially the usual or correct way.

words.tr: phrase. 安顿下来；适应新环境（如新家、新工作或新国家）
words.ex: They settled in a small town after moving.
words.ex_cn: 搬家后，他们在一个小镇安顿下来。
words.en: To begin to feel comfortable in a new place or situation.

words.ex: The boxing match took place in an arena.
words.ex_cn: 拳击比赛在竞技场举行。
words.en: An arena is a place or scene of activity, debate, or conflict, especially one where a competition or performance is held.

words.ex: He goes to the gym every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身房。
words.en: A gym is a place equipped for physical exercise and training, especially for athletes or for people who want to keep fit.

words.ex: He submitted the documentation for his project.
words.ex_cn: 他提交了项目的文件。
words.en: Documentation refers to the act of providing documents or the documents themselves, which serve as evidence or records of something.

words.tr: n. 证明书；资格证书；证件
words.ex: He showed his credential to enter the building.
words.ex_cn: 他出示了证件以进入大楼。
words.en: A credential is a document that proves your identity or qualifications.

words.ex: The distribution of students in the class is even.
words.ex_cn: 班级里学生的分布是均匀的。
words.en: The process of giving out or spreading something, or the way in which something is spread or arranged over an area or among a group of people.

words.tr:
adj. 资深的；高级的；年长的；
n. 年长者；大四学生；
words.ex: He is a senior engineer with 20 years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有20年经验的资深工程师。
words.en: Higher in rank, status, or importance; older in age.

words.tr:
v. 转移；转让；调任；
n. 转移；转让；调任；
words.ex: He will transfer the money to his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他将把钱转到他的银行账户。
words.en: If you transfer something or someone from one place to another, or they transfer from one place to another, they go from the first place to the second.

words.ex: They explore the forest to find hidden caves.
words.ex_cn: 他们探索森林以寻找隐藏的洞穴。
words.en: To explore means to travel over or through an unfamiliar area in order to learn about it or to search for something valuable.

words.tr: n. 自立；依靠自己；自力更生
words.ex: He learns self-reliance from living alone.
words.ex_cn: 他通过独自生活学会自立。
words.en: Self-reliance is the ability to do things and make decisions by yourself, without needing other people to help you.

words.ex: He lives independently and makes his own decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他独立生活，并自己做决定。
words.en: If one thing or person is independent of another, they are separate and not connected, so that the first one is not affected or influenced by the second.

words.ex: Farmers cultivate rice in the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农民在田里种植水稻。
words.en: To cultivate land means to prepare it and grow crops on it. To cultivate a particular quality, skill, or attitude means to try hard to develop it and make it stronger.

words.ex: His personality is very friendly and outgoing.
words.ex_cn: 他的个性非常友好和外向。
words.en: The combination of characteristics or qualities that form an individual's distinctive character.

words.tr: v. 体现；使具体化；包含
words.ex: He embodies kindness and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他体现了善良和耐心。
words.en: To embody means to represent a quality or an idea exactly; to include or contain something.

words.ex: Parents often spoil their children with too many toys.
words.ex_cn: 父母经常用太多玩具宠坏孩子。
words.en: To spoil something means to reduce its quality or value, often by damaging it in some way. It can also mean to treat someone, especially a child, with too much kindness or indulgence, leading to their detriment.

words.ex: He has a positive attitude toward life.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活持积极的态度。
words.en: If you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

words.tr: adj. 角的；有角的；尖角的；
words.ex: The angular shape of the triangle is clear.
words.ex_cn: 三角形的角形很清晰。
words.en: having angles or sharp corners; lean and bony

words.ex: He wants to study engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习工程。
words.en: Engineering is the work involved in designing and constructing engines and machinery, or structures such as roads and bridges. Engineering is also the subject studied by people who want to do this work.

words.tr: n. （政治、商业或社会性）活动；运动；
words.ex: The city launched a campaign to reduce plastic waste.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市发起了一项减少塑料垃圾的活动。
words.en: A campaign is a planned set of activities that people carry out over a period of time in order to achieve something such as social or political change.

words.tr: n. 倡议；主动权；自发性；措施；
words.ex: The school launched an initiative to reduce plastic use.
words.ex_cn: 学校发起了一项减少塑料使用的倡议。
words.en: An initiative is an important act or statement that is intended to solve a problem.

words.tr:
v. 阻碍；妨碍
n. （带盖）篮子
words.ex: Rain hampered our picnic plans.
words.ex_cn: 雨妨碍了我们的野餐计划。
words.en: If something hampers you, it makes it difficult for you to do something.

words.ex: He is an all-around athlete who plays basketball, soccer, and tennis.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名全能运动员，打篮球、足球和网球。
words.en: An all-around person is someone who is good at many different things.

words.ex: He solved the problem on his own.
words.ex_cn: 他自己解决了这个问题。
words.en: If you do something on your own, you do it without any help from other people.

words.tr: phrase. 取得巨大成功；一举成名；飞黄腾达
words.ex: He wants to make it big as a singer in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他想在城市里成为一名大红大紫的歌手。
words.en: To achieve great success or become famous.

words.ex: He decided to take control of his life.
words.ex_cn: 他决定掌控自己的生活。
words.en: To take control of something means to gain the power or authority to manage or direct it.

words.ex: She is pregnant and will have a baby next month.
words.ex_cn: 她怀孕了，下个月就要生宝宝了。
words.en: Having a baby developing in the uterus.

words.tr: n. 引人注目的人或物；溅污的斑点；
words.ex: The new singer became a splash on the music scene.
words.ex_cn: 这位新歌手成为了音乐界引人注目的人物。
words.en: To cause (a liquid) to scatter in drops or small quantities, especially by striking or moving suddenly; to move or strike so as to cause a liquid to scatter in this way.

words.tr:
v. 声称；索赔；
n. 声称；索要；
words.ex: He claims that he saw a UFO last night.
words.ex_cn: 他声称自己昨晚看到了不明飞行物。
words.en: If you say that someone claims that something is true, you mean they say that it is true but you are not sure whether or not they are telling the truth.

words.tr: adj. 不同寻常的；非凡的；显著的；值得注意的；
words.ex: She made a remarkable improvement in just one month.
words.ex_cn: 她在短短一个月内取得了不同寻常的进步。
words.en: Unusual or striking in a way that attracts attention.

words.tr: n. 揭露；被揭示的真相；
words.ex: The letter was a revelation about his secret life.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他隐秘的生活。
words.en: A revelation is a surprising and previously unknown fact that has been disclosed to others.

words.tr:
adj. 目前的；在场的；
n. 目前；礼物；
v. 呈现；提出；
words.ex: The present situation is very difficult.
words.ex_cn: 目前的形势非常困难。
words.en: If you say that someone is present at an event, you mean that they are there.

words.ex: He bought fresh vegetables from the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他从本地市场买了新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: Something that is local relates to a particular area or to the area where you live.

words.ex: There was a surge in sales during the holiday season.
words.ex_cn: 假期期间销量激增。
words.en: If something surges, it increases suddenly and greatly, after having been steady or only small in size or amount.

words.ex: He spoke out against anti-semitism in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中反对反犹太主义。
words.en: Hostility to or prejudice against Jews.

words.ex: I want to find out why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想弄清楚他为什么迟到。
words.en: To discover a fact or piece of information, often by making an effort to do so.

words.ex: The origin of this tradition is unknown.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源不明。
words.en: The origin of something is the point or place where it begins, or the cause from which it arises.

words.ex: He will cancel the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会取消会议。
words.en: If you cancel something that has been arranged, you stop it from happening. If you cancel an order for goods or services, you tell the person or organization supplying them that you no longer wish to receive them.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.ex: She will give birth to a baby next month.
words.ex_cn: 她下个月要生孩子。
words.en: To bring a baby or young animal into the world by birth.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 推出（新产品）；发表（言论）；说出（想法）
words.ex: The company is expected to come out with a new product next month.
words.ex_cn: v. 公司预计下个月将发布一款新产品。
words.en: To introduce or make known to the public, especially a new product or idea.

words.tr:
n. 框架；结构；骨架；模式；
v. 表达；陷害；
words.ex: The picture is in a wooden frame.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画在一个木制框架里。
words.en: A frame is a structure that forms a border or support for something, such as a picture or a window. It can also refer to the process of making or constructing something, or the act of falsely incriminating someone.

words.ex: He keeps his diary private.
words.ex_cn: 他把日记保密。
words.en: If something is private, it is for the use of one person or group, rather than for the general public.

words.tr: v. 兑现；递送；交付；发表；为…接生；
words.ex: He promised to deliver on his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺要兑现自己的目标。
words.en: To bring and hand over (a letter, parcel, or ordered goods) to the proper recipient or address.

words.ex: I will definitely come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 我肯定会来参加派对。
words.en: without any doubt; certainly

words.tr: n. 图像；形象；画面；影像；
words.ex: The photo shows a clear image of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了山脉的清晰图像。
words.en: An image is a picture that you have in your mind, especially about what someone or something is like or the way they look.

words.tr: n. 纳粹党所用的十字记号
words.ex: No example sentences
words.ex_cn: 没有例句
words.en: The swastika is an ancient symbol used in various cultures, often representing good fortune, which was later adopted by the Nazi Party as its emblem.

words.tr:
n. 接触；联系；
v. 接触；联系；
words.ex: The two balls made contact when they collided.
words.ex_cn: 两个球在碰撞时发生了接触。
words.en: Contact refers to the act of communicating with someone, especially regularly, or the state of touching something.

words.ex: He will submit his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会提交他的作业。
words.en: To yield or surrender (oneself) to the will or authority of another.

words.ex: He won the spelling contest.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了拼写比赛。
words.en: A contest is a competition or a struggle for victory between individuals or groups.

words.tr: adj. 杰出的；尚未处理的；
words.ex: He is an outstanding student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名杰出的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as outstanding, you think that they are very remarkable and impressive.

words.ex: He exclaim when he saw the surprise.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到惊喜时，他大喊起来。
words.en: If you exclaim, you say something suddenly and loudly, often because you are surprised, excited, or angry.

words.ex: There is strong competition between the two companies.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司之间竞争激烈。
words.en: Competition is a situation in which two or more people or groups are trying to get something which not everyone can have.

words.ex: He is prone to making small mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他容易犯小错误。
words.en: If someone is prone to something, they are likely to do it or experience it.

words.ex: His story was an exaggeration of the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他的故事是对事实的夸张。
words.en: An exaggeration is a statement that represents something as better or worse than it really is.

words.ex: His collection of old coins is very rare.
words.ex_cn: 他收集的旧硬币非常稀有。
words.en: A collection is a group of things, often of the same type, that have been gathered together over a period of time.

words.ex: There are numerous books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有许多书。
words.en: If people or things are numerous, they exist or are present in large numbers.

words.ex: The publication of his book was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 他的书的出版被推迟了。
words.en: The act of making something available to the public, especially a book, magazine, or newspaper.

words.ex: The magic show amazed the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演让孩子们感到惊奇。
words.en: To amaze someone means to surprise them very much.

words.tr:
prep. 遍及；各处；自始至终；
adv. 自始至终；到处；
words.ex: She traveled throughout the country.
words.ex_cn: 她遍及全国旅行。
words.en: In every part of a place or thing; during the whole of a period of time.

words.ex: He will flee from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 他会从着火的房子里逃走。
words.en: If you flee from something or someone, you leave them quickly because you are afraid of them or because you do not want to be involved with them.

words.tr: phrase. 在……中寻求庇护；在……中找到避难所
words.ex: He finds refuge in music when he feels sad.
words.ex_cn: 当他感到悲伤时，他从音乐中寻找慰藉。
words.en: To find refuge in something means to seek shelter, comfort, or safety in it, especially from danger or trouble.

words.tr: phrase. 逃入（某处）以寻求庇护；借（某事物）逃避现实或困境
words.ex: When it started to rain, we took refuge in a small shed.
words.ex_cn: 开始下雨时，我们躲进了一个小棚子里。
words.en: To seek shelter or protection in a place or thing, often during a difficult or dangerous situation.

words.ex: He felt a corporal pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到身体上的疼痛。
words.en: A corporal is a non-commissioned officer in the army, above a private and below a sergeant. As an adjective, it refers to the body or physical condition.

words.ex: The survival of the animals depends on the weather.
words.ex_cn: 这些动物的生存取决于天气。
words.en: The state or fact of continuing to live or exist, typically in spite of an accident, ordeal, or difficult circumstances.

words.ex: The movie was incredible.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影太棒了。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as incredible, you like them very much or are impressed by them, because they are extremely or unusually good.

words.tr: v. 幸存；生存；存活；艰难挺过；
words.ex: He survived the accident with minor injuries.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中幸存下来，只有轻微受伤。
words.en: If you survive in a dangerous situation, you continue to live or exist in spite of it.

words.ex: He likes to wander in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢晚饭后在公园里徘徊。
words.en: If you wander in a place, you walk around there in a casual way, often without intending to go in any particular direction or to any particular place.

words.tr:
v. 记录；准确地描述；俘虏；吸引；
n. 抓捕；
words.ex: The camera can capture the moment clearly.
words.ex_cn: 相机可以清晰地记录下这一瞬间。
words.en: To capture someone or something means to catch them, especially after a chase.

words.ex: The school mascot is a happy tiger.
words.ex_cn: 学校的吉祥物是一只快乐的老虎。
words.en: A mascot is a person, animal, or object that is adopted by a group as a symbolic figure to bring them good luck.

words.ex: The thieves burst into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 小偷在夜里闯入了房子。
words.en: If you burst into a particular kind of activity, you suddenly start doing it.

words.ex: The knight held up his shield to block the arrow.
words.ex_cn: 骑士举起盾牌来挡箭。
words.en: A shield is a piece of armor held in the hand or worn on the arm to protect the body from missiles or blows. It can also refer to something that protects or defends someone or something from harm or danger.

words.ex: The soldier picked up a bullet from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 士兵从地上捡起一颗子弹。
words.en: A bullet is a small piece of metal with a pointed or rounded end, which is fired from a gun.

words.ex: The baby is crawling on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在地板上爬。
words.en: To move slowly on hands and knees or by dragging the body close to the ground.

words.ex: He sneaked out of the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 他晚上偷偷溜出了房子。
words.en: To move quietly and secretly in order to avoid being noticed.

words.ex: He overlooked the mistake in the report.
words.ex_cn: 他忽略了报告中的错误。
words.en: If you overlook a fact or problem, you do not notice it, or do not realize how important it is.

words.ex: The dog fell into a deep pit.
words.ex_cn: 狗掉进了一个深坑。
words.en: A pit is a large hole in the ground, either natural or as a result of digging. It can also refer to a hollow or indentation in a surface, or a place where something is extracted, such as a mine. As a verb, to pit means to set someone or something in competition or to make a hollow or indentation in a surface.

words.ex: The battalion marched slowly through the town.
words.ex_cn: 那个营缓缓穿过小镇。
words.en: A battalion is a large group of soldiers that consists of three or more companies.

words.tr: phrase. 吸收；领会；接待；接受
words.ex: Plants take in sunlight to make food.
words.ex_cn: 植物吸收阳光来制造食物。
words.en: To take something in means to understand it or to absorb it. It can also mean to deceive someone or to make clothes smaller.

words.tr: n. 谜；难以理解的事物；
words.ex: The mystery of the missing key puzzled everyone.
words.ex_cn: 丢失的钥匙这个谜题让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: Something that is difficult or impossible to understand or explain.

words.tr:
v. 使脱落；去除；
n. 棚屋；
words.ex: The tree sheds its leaves in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在秋天落叶。
words.en: A shed is a small building, usually made of wood, used for storing things such as garden tools. When something sheds, it loses its covering, such as leaves or hair, or it gets rid of something it no longer needs.

words.tr: adv. 意外地；出乎意料地；
words.ex: He arrived unexpectedly at my house.
words.ex_cn: 他意外地来到我家。
words.en: In a way that was not expected; surprisingly.

words.ex: Please take pity on the poor dog and give it some food.
words.ex_cn: 请可怜这只可怜的狗，给它一些食物。
words.en: To feel sympathy for someone because they are in a difficult or unpleasant situation.

words.tr: n. 孤儿；失去生母的幼小动物
words.ex: The boy lives with his uncle because he is an orphan.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩和叔叔住在一起，因为他是个孤儿。
words.en: An orphan is a child whose parents are dead.

words.ex: Her smile has a special charm.
words.ex_cn: 她的微笑有一种特别的魅力。
words.en: If you say that someone has charm, you mean that they behave in a friendly and pleasant way that makes people like them. A charm is also a small ornament that is fixed to a bracelet or necklace.

words.tr: n. （德国）党卫军（Schutzstaffel）；（美国）中学（Secondary School）
words.ex: No example sentences
words.ex_cn: 没有例句
words.en: A very small amount or degree.

words.tr: n. 党卫军（纳粹德国的精英军事和警察组织）
words.ex: No example sentences
words.ex_cn: 没有例句
words.en: The Schutzstaffel, or SS, was a major paramilitary organization under Adolf Hitler and the Nazi Party in Nazi Germany.

words.ex: He felt intense pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到剧烈的疼痛。
words.en: If you describe an activity as intense, you mean that it is very serious and concentrated, and often involves doing a great deal in a short time.

words.tr: adj. 突出的；杰出的；显著的；
words.ex: He is a prominent scientist in the field of medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他是医学领域的一位突出的科学家。
words.en: Someone or something that is prominent is important and well-known, or is positioned in a way that makes them easily seen or noticed.

words.ex: Parents should foster good habits in children.
words.ex_cn: 父母应该培养孩子的好习惯。
words.en: To foster something means to encourage and promote its development.

words.ex: The government used propaganda to influence people's opinions.
words.ex_cn: 政府使用宣传来影响人们的观点。
words.en: Information, especially of a biased or misleading nature, used to promote a political cause or point of view.

words.ex: He showed his identity card to enter the building.
words.ex_cn: 他出示了身份证以进入大楼。
words.en: Your identity is who you are, or the qualities of a person or group that make them different from others.

words.tr: n. 伪装；假象；虚伪的表现
words.ex: He was accused of using pretense to gain sympathy.
words.ex_cn: 他被指控利用伪装来博取同情。
words.en: A pretense is an action or way of behaving that is intended to make people believe something that is not true.

words.ex: The law compels drivers to wear seat belts.
words.ex_cn: 法律强迫司机系安全带。
words.en: If a situation, a rule, or a person compels you to do something, they force you to do it.

words.ex: The memory of the accident still haunts him.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故的记忆仍然长期困扰着他。
words.en: If something unpleasant haunts you, you keep thinking or worrying about it over a long period of time. A place that is haunted is believed to be visited regularly by a ghost.

words.tr:
n. 坟墓；
adj. 严重的；
words.ex: They visited the grave of their grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他们参观了祖父的坟墓。
words.en: A grave is a place where a dead person is buried. When used as an adjective, grave means serious or solemn.

words.ex: The police found a clue at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了一条线索。
words.en: A clue is an object or piece of information that helps to solve a problem or mystery.

words.tr: phrase. 白费地； 徒劳地
words.ex: He cried in vain for help.
words.ex_cn: 他呼救却无济于事。
words.en: If you do something in vain, you do not succeed in achieving what you intend.

words.ex: The scientist made a breakthrough in cancer research.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家在癌症研究中取得了突破。
words.en: A breakthrough is a significant development or achievement that helps to solve a problem or improve a situation.

words.tr:
v. 突出；强调；高光；
n. 最突出的部分；
words.ex: The teacher highlighted the key words in the text.
words.ex_cn: 老师把文中的关键词突出了。
words.en: To highlight something means to make it stand out or to emphasize it, often because it is important or interesting.

words.ex: The army tried to invade the neighboring country.
words.ex_cn: 军队试图侵犯邻国。
words.en: To enter a country, town, or region by force in order to take control of it.

words.ex: The horror of the dark made her scream.
words.ex_cn: 对黑暗的恐惧让她尖叫。
words.en: A feeling of great fear, shock, or disgust.

words.ex: The golfer aimed for the center of the fairway.
words.ex_cn: 高尔夫球手瞄准了球道的中心。
words.en: In golf, the fairway is the part of the course that leads directly from the tee to the green, kept mowed and free of rough.

words.ex: The children are vibrant and full of energy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们充满活力。
words.en: If you describe something as vibrant, you mean that it is bright, lively, and full of energy.

words.ex: The child's recovery was a miracle.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的康复是个奇迹。
words.en: A miracle is an event that cannot be explained by the laws of nature and is therefore considered to be the work of a divine agency.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.ex: The play ended in a tragedy when the hero died.
words.ex_cn: 当英雄去世时，这部戏剧以悲剧收场。
words.en: A tragedy is an extremely sad event or situation.

words.ex: The invention of the internet changed our era.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明改变了我们的时代。
words.en: An era is a period of time that is considered as a single unit because of a particular characteristic or event.

words.ex: They live idyllically in a small village by the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他们在一个海边的小村庄里过着田园般的生活。
words.en: In a manner that is extremely happy, peaceful, or picturesque.

words.ex: Many refugees are stateless due to conflicts in their homeland.
words.ex_cn: 许多难民由于祖国的冲突而成为无国籍者。
words.en: A stateless person is someone who is not considered as a national by any state under the operation of its law.

words.ex: The teacher designated him as the group leader.
words.ex_cn: 老师指派他为组长。
words.en: If you designate someone or something as a particular thing, you formally give them that description or name.

words.tr: n. 聚居区；犹太人区；贫民区
words.ex: He grew up in a poor ghetto.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个贫穷的贫民区长大。
words.en: A ghetto is a part of a city in which members of a minority group live, especially because of social, legal, or economic pressure.

words.ex: The desert has a harsh climate.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠的气候非常严酷。
words.en: If you describe something as harsh, you mean that it is extremely difficult and unpleasant to live in, do, or experience, especially because it is very cold, hot, or violent.

words.tr:
v. 细述；叙述
n. 叙述；重新计票
words.ex: He tried to recount the accident to the police.
words.ex_cn: 他试图向警察重新叙述那场事故。
words.en: To recount means to tell someone about something that happened, often in detail; or to count something again to make sure the number is correct.

words.ex: He felt nostalgia when he saw his old toy.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到自己的旧玩具时，感到怀旧。
words.en: A sentimental longing or wistful affection for the past, typically for a period or place with happy personal associations.

words.tr:
n. 担忧；关注；
v. 涉及；
words.ex: His main concern is his child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 他主要的担忧是孩子的安全。
words.en: If something concerns you, it worries you or causes you to feel anxious.

words.ex: The extent of his knowledge surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的知识广度让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The area or length to which something extends.

words.ex: The earthquake caused total devastation in the city.
words.ex_cn: 地震给这座城市造成了严重的破坏。
words.en: The state of being devastated; severe and widespread destruction or damage.

words.ex: At first, he did not like math.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他不喜欢数学。
words.en: At the beginning; initially.

words.tr:
n. 担忧；关注；
v. 涉及；
words.ex: His main concern is his child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 他主要的担忧是孩子的安全。
words.en: If something concerns you, it worries you or causes you to feel anxious.

words.ex: Please attend to your homework now.
words.ex_cn: 现在请专心做你的作业。
words.en: To deal with or take care of something; to give attention to someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 头；脑袋；上端；首脑；
v. 朝…行进；居首位；领导；
adj. 头的；主要的；
words.ex: He hurt his head when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时伤到了头。
words.en: The upper part of the human body, or the front or upper part of the body of an animal, typically separated from the rest of the body by a neck, and containing the brain, mouth, and sense organs.

words.tr: adj. 重大的；重要的；影响明显的；
words.ex: This discovery is a significant step forward.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现是一个重大的进步。
words.en: Something that is significant is important or large enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.ex: She has excellent night vision.
words.ex_cn: 她有很好的夜视能力。
words.en: Vision is the ability to see, the area that you can see, the ability to imagine how a country, society, industry, etc. could develop in the future and to plan in a suitable way, or an experience in which you see something that is not really there.

words.ex: The problem is a global issue.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题是一个全球性的问题。
words.en: relating to the whole world; worldwide

words.tr:
n. 信号；
v. 用信号通知；
words.ex: The traffic light is a signal to stop.
words.ex_cn: 交通灯是一个停止的信号。
words.en: A signal is a gesture, sound, or action which is intended to give a particular message to the person who sees or hears it.

words.tr: phrase. 至于； 关于；按着；根据
words.ex: I don't know as to when he will come.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他什么时候来。
words.en: Used to indicate what something is about or concerns.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；批判性的；关键的；危急的；临界的；
words.ex: Water is critical for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you are critical of someone or something, you show that you disapprove of them. In a critical situation, things are very serious and dangerous. A critical time or event is extremely important because it will affect future events.

words.tr: phrase. 基本规则；约定俗成的规矩；（尤指体育比赛中的）场地规则
words.ex: Ground rules were established to ensure a smooth operation of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 设立基本规则以确保会议顺利进行。
words.en: A basic rule or principle that is used as a foundation for making decisions or judgments.

words.tr: phrase. 禁止进入的；禁止使用的；不可触碰的
words.ex: The area is off limits to all unauthorized personnel.
words.ex_cn: 该区域禁止所有未经授权的人员进入。
words.en: If an area is off limits, you are not allowed to go there.

words.tr: adj. 适当的；合适的；恰当的；
words.ex: This dress is appropriate for a wedding.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子适合参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is appropriate is suitable or acceptable for a particular situation.

words.tr:
n. 一系列；（变化）范围；山脉；
v. （在某范围内）变化；包括（各种不同的人或物）；
words.ex: The store offers a range of colors.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供一系列颜色。
words.en: A range of things is a number of different things of the same general kind.

words.ex: The two companies showed good cooperation on the project.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司在这个项目上表现出良好的合作。
words.en: Cooperation is the process of working or acting together, which can be seen in many aspects of life, including business, science, and social interactions.

words.tr: phrase. 曾经；一度；在某个时刻
words.ex: At one point, he forgot his keys.
words.ex_cn: 有一刻，他忘了带钥匙。
words.en: At a particular time in the past.

words.ex: The doctor said the patient needs urgent care.
words.ex_cn: 医生说病人需要紧急治疗。
words.en: If something is urgent, it needs to be dealt with as soon as possible.

words.ex: He dismissed her advice and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他不理会她的建议，走开了。
words.en: If you dismiss someone, you send them away or allow them to leave.

words.ex: The experiment demonstrates that water boils at 100°C.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验证明水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
words.en: To demonstrate means to show something clearly by giving proof or evidence.

words.tr:
n. 地址；演讲；
v. 解决；向…讲话；
words.ex: Please write your address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的地址写在表格上。
words.en: The particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated; a formal speech delivered to an audience.

words.ex: He felt great woe after losing his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他失去狗后感到极大的悲伤。
words.en: Woe is great sadness.

words.tr:
v. 生产；获利；
n. 产量；
words.ex: This farm yields a lot of wheat each year.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每年生产大量小麦。
words.en: If you yield to someone or something, you stop resisting them. If a tree or plant yields fruit or flowers, it produces them.

words.tr: 短语动词。向……宣战；公开反对或打击（某事物）
words.ex: The country decided to declare war on its enemy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家决定向它的敌人宣战。
words.en: To formally announce the beginning of hostilities against a particular country or group.

words.ex: I checked the class schedule for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我查看了明天的课程时间表。
words.en: A schedule is a plan that gives a list of events or tasks and the times at which each one should happen or be done.

words.tr:
v. 有益于；有助于；
n. 利益；好处；
words.ex: Exercise benefits your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有益于你的健康。
words.en: A benefit is something that helps you or improves your life in some way.

words.ex: He showed great concentration while solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解这道数学题时非常专注。
words.en: Concentration is the ability to focus all your attention on one thing without being distracted.

words.ex: Please ensure the door is locked.
words.ex_cn: 请确保门锁好了。
words.en: To make certain that something will occur or be the case.

words.ex: Thanks to his help, I passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 多亏了他的帮助，我通过了考试。
words.en: used to say that something good has happened because of someone or something

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的表现非常出色。
words.en: The act of performing a play, concert, or some other form of entertainment.

words.tr:
v. 发射；发起；启动；
n. 发射；投掷；启动；
words.ex: They will launch a rocket tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将发射一枚火箭。
words.en: To launch something means to send it into the air, space, or water, especially with a lot of force or effort, or to start an activity, event, or project.

words.ex: He built a successful career in medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他在医学领域建立了成功的事业。
words.en: A career is the job or series of jobs that you do during your working life, especially if you continue to get better jobs and earn more money.

words.ex: The proportion of students who passed the test was high.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生比例很高。
words.en: A proportion is a part of a whole, or the relationship of one part to another in terms of size, amount, or degree.

words.tr:
n. 下降；衰退；
v. 下降；衰退；
words.ex: There was a sharp decline in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额大幅下降。
words.en: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength.

words.ex: He will enroll in the English course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将注册英语课程。
words.en: To officially register or enlist oneself or someone else in a course, institution, or organization.

words.ex: The rain offset the heat yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天的雨抵消了炎热。
words.en: If one thing is offset by another, the effect of the first thing is reduced by the second, so that any advantage or disadvantage is cancelled out.

words.ex: He read the previous chapter last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚读了前一章。
words.en: Existing or occurring before in time or order.

words.tr: v. 使留下深刻印象；使铭记；
words.ex: His speech impressed everyone in the room.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲给在场的每个人留下了深刻印象。
words.en: If someone or something impresses you, you feel great admiration for them.

words.ex: He worked hard to attain his goals.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以达到他的目标。
words.en: If you attain something, you gain it or achieve it, often after a lot of effort.

words.ex: The solution to the problem is simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的解决办法很简单。
words.en: A solution to a problem is a way of dealing with it so that the difficulty is removed.

words.ex: This sentence is easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这个句子很容易理解。
words.en: A sentence is a group of words which, when they are written down, begin with a capital letter and end with a full stop, question mark, or exclamation mark. Most sentences contain a subject and a verb.

words.tr: n. 隔离；分离；种族隔离；
words.ex: The school practiced racial segregation in the past.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校过去实行种族隔离。
words.en: Segregation is the policy or practice of separating people of different races, sexes, or religions and treating them in a different way.

words.ex: A bird emerged from the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一只鸟从树中浮现出来。
words.en: If something or someone emerges, they come out of or move out of something and become visible.

words.ex: He wrote his testament before he died.
words.ex_cn: 他在去世前立了遗嘱。
words.en: A testament is a statement of belief or a document that serves as proof or evidence of something.

words.ex: I will see you in person tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天亲自见你。
words.en: If you do something in person, you do it yourself rather than letting someone else do it for you.

words.tr: phrase. 在…面前；当着…的面；有…在场时
words.ex: He stayed quiet in the presence of his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他在老师面前保持安静。
words.en: When you are in the presence of someone or something, you are in the same place as them and they are there with you.

words.ex: He lived in Paris for a decade.
words.ex_cn: 他在巴黎生活了十年。
words.en: A decade is a period of ten years, especially one that begins with a year ending in 0, for example 1980 to 1989.

words.ex: The bridge can withstand strong winds.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥能经受住强风。
words.en: If something or someone withstands a force or action, they survive it or do not give in to it.

words.ex: After running for an hour, he felt fatigue.
words.ex_cn: 跑了一个小时后，他感到疲乏。
words.en: A feeling of extreme physical or mental tiredness.

words.ex: The rain set in after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 午饭后雨开始下了。
words.en: If something sets in, especially something unpleasant, it begins and seems likely to continue or develop.

words.tr:
n. 最大限度；最大量；
adj. 最大极限的；最多的；
words.ex: The maximum of the crowd is 100 people.
words.ex_cn: 人群的上限是100人。
words.en: The greatest or highest amount possible or attained.

words.tr:
adj. 智力的；
n. 知识分子；
words.ex: He is an intellectual person who loves solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱解决数学问题的智力型人。
words.en: An intellectual is someone who spends a lot of time studying and thinking about complicated ideas.

words.ex: He spoke in regard to the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他谈到了新的校规。
words.en: Concerning or about something.

words.ex: His neglect of the project caused delays.
words.ex_cn: 他对项目的疏忽导致了延误。
words.en: If you neglect someone or something, you fail to give them the attention or care that they need.

words.ex: I will arrange a meeting for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我将为明天安排一次会议。
words.en: If you arrange an event or meeting, you make plans for it to happen.

words.tr:
v. 吹；打击；
n. 打击；
words.ex: The wind blows the leaves away.
words.ex_cn: 风吹走了树叶。
words.en: To move air or gas forcefully; to strike something with force.

words.tr: v. 使合格；使具有资格；
words.ex: He studied hard to qualify for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以获得这份工作的资格。
words.en: To qualify means to meet the necessary conditions or standards to be eligible for something or to perform a particular role.

words.tr: phrase. 编造；组成；弥补；化妆；和好
words.ex: He made up a story to explain his delay.
words.ex_cn: 他编了一个故事来解释他的迟到。
words.en: To make up means to form something by combining or assembling parts, to invent a story or excuse, to apply cosmetics, or to reconcile after a disagreement.

words.ex: He responded to the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: If you respond to something that is done or said, you react to it by doing or saying something yourself.

words.tr:
adj. 文盲的；无知的；
n. 文盲；无知识的人；
words.ex: He is illiterate and cannot read simple signs.
words.ex_cn: 他是文盲，无法阅读简单的标识。
words.en: Someone who is illiterate cannot read or write.

words.tr: v. “ride”的过去分词； adj. 受困扰的；
words.ex: The horse has been ridden every day.
words.ex_cn: 这匹马每天都被骑。
words.en: If a place or thing is ridden with something, it is full of it or dominated by it.

words.tr: phrase. 充满……的；深受……折磨的（通常指问题、疾病或困难）
words.ex: The report was ridden with errors.
words.ex_cn: 这份报告错误百出。
words.en: To be filled with or dominated by something, typically something unpleasant.

words.ex: The bus stops at the terminal at 9 PM.
words.ex_cn: 公交车晚上9点到达终点站。
words.en: A terminal is a place where vehicles, passengers, or goods begin or end a journey. It can also refer to a computer device at which a user enters data or commands.

words.tr: n. 痴迷；困扰；着魔；强迫观念；
words.ex: His obsession with video games made him ignore his studies.
words.ex_cn: 他对电子游戏的痴迷让他忽略了学业。
words.en: An obsession is an idea or thought that continually preoccupies or intrudes on a person's mind.

words.tr: adj. 严重的；严厉的；非常困难的；
words.ex: The storm caused severe damage to the houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对房屋造成了严重的破坏。
words.en: If something is severe, it is very bad or very serious.

words.ex: The government imposed a new tax on sugar.
words.ex_cn: 政府对糖征收了一项新税。
words.en: To impose means to officially force a rule, tax, punishment, etc. to be obeyed or received.

words.tr: n. 有价值的人或物；长处；
words.ex: He is an asset to the team because he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有价值的人，因为他工作努力。
words.en: An asset is something valuable that an individual, corporation, or country owns or controls with the expectation that it will provide a future benefit.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 在许多方面；从多方面来看
words.ex: In many respects, this book is better than the last one.
words.ex_cn: 在许多方面，这本书比上一本更好。
words.en: In many ways or aspects.

words.ex: They communicate well with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此沟通得很好。
words.en: To communicate means to share or exchange information, news, or ideas, especially by speaking or writing.

words.ex: The warden checks the prison every morning.
words.ex_cn: 狱长每天早上检查监狱。
words.en: A warden is a person who is responsible for the supervision of a particular place or thing, or for ensuring that laws or rules are obeyed.

words.ex: He dumped the trash into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾倒进了垃圾桶。
words.en: To dump something means to get rid of it quickly and without care, often because it is no longer wanted or needed. It can also refer to the place where waste is left.

words.tr: adj. 遵守纪律的； v. “discipline”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a disciplined student who always arrives on time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个遵守纪律的学生，总是准时到达。
words.en: Someone who is disciplined behaves in a controlled way, obeying rules or standards.

words.ex: My colleague helped me with the report.
words.ex_cn: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。
words.en: A colleague is someone you work with, especially in a professional job.

words.ex: This school uses a progressive teaching method.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校使用一种先进的教学方法。
words.en: A progressive person or idea is one that is modern and new, and is interested in change and improvement.

words.ex: Going first is a privilege, not a right.
words.ex_cn: 优先权是一种特权，而不是权利。
words.en: A privilege is a special right or advantage that only one person or group has.

words.ex: The school will equip the lab with new computers.
words.ex_cn: 学校将为实验室配备新电脑。
words.en: To provide someone or something with the necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
adj. 典范的；典型的；
n. 文学经典；名著；优秀的典范；
words.ex: This movie is a classic comedy.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部典范的喜剧。
words.en: A classic is something that is judged to be of the highest quality and outstanding of its kind.

words.ex: The new job enriched his life.
words.ex_cn: 这份新工作使他的生活富裕起来。
words.en: To enrich something means to improve its quality, often by adding something to it.

words.tr: adj. 了解情况的； v. 通知；告知；“inform”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is an informed voter who reads the news daily.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个了解情况的选民，每天阅读新闻。
words.en: If someone is informed, they know a lot about a particular subject or situation.

words.ex: He gave an arrogant answer to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他傲慢地回答了老师的问题。
words.en: Someone who is arrogant behaves in a proud, unpleasant way towards other people because they believe that they are more important than others.

words.ex: The two sides started negotiation to solve the conflict.
words.ex_cn: 双方开始了谈判以解决冲突。
words.en: Negotiation is a discussion aimed at reaching an agreement.

words.tr:
n. 释放；发布；
v. 释放；发布；
words.ex: The release of the prisoner made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 囚犯的释放让每个人都高兴。
words.en: To release something means to let it go or to allow it to be free, or to make something available to the public.

words.ex: Nelson Mandela was a prominent antiapartheid activist.
words.ex_cn: 纳尔逊·曼德拉是著名的反种族隔离活动家。
words.en: Opposed to the policy of apartheid, especially in South Africa.

words.tr:
adj. 军事的；军用的；
n. 军队；武装力量；
words.ex: The military base is near the border.
words.ex_cn: 军事基地靠近边境。
words.en: relating to or characteristic of soldiers or armed forces

words.tr: phrase. 满足于； 对 ... 感到满足
words.ex: He is content with his small house.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的小房子感到满足。
words.en: To be satisfied with what one has or is, without desiring more or something else.

words.ex: He took a defensive position to protect the goal.
words.ex_cn: 他采取了防守姿势来保护球门。
words.en: If someone is defensive, they are behaving in a way that shows they are anxious or angry because they feel that they are being criticized.

words.ex: France was an ally of the United States in the war.
words.ex_cn: 法国在战争中是美国的同盟者。
words.en: An ally is a country, organization, or person that helps and supports another country, organization, or person in a difficult situation.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；逐步增长；加强
words.ex: He builds up his strength by running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天跑步来增强体力。
words.en: To increase or develop something gradually; to accumulate or amass something over time.

words.ex: The gallant soldier saved his comrades in battle.
words.ex_cn: 这位英勇的士兵在战斗中救了他的战友们。
words.en: If someone is gallant, they behave bravely and honorably in a dangerous or difficult situation. It can also describe someone who is very polite and kind towards women.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 在进行中；在准备中；在行进中
words.ex: The project is well in train and expected to be completed on time.
words.ex_cn: 项目进展顺利，预计将按时完成。
words.en: In progress; underway.

words.ex: There is a five-minute interval between the two classes.
words.ex_cn: 两节课之间有五分钟的间隔。
words.en: An interval is a period of time between two events or dates.

words.ex: This medicine is effective against colds.
words.ex_cn: 这种药对感冒有效。
words.en: Something that is effective works well and produces the results that were intended.

words.tr: n. 安全；保障；防护措施；
words.ex: The school improved security to protect students.
words.ex_cn: 学校加强了安全措施以保护学生。
words.en: Security refers to the state of being free from danger or threat, or measures taken to ensure safety.

words.tr:
n. 潜力；
adj. 潜在的；
words.ex: The young athlete shows great potential.
words.ex_cn: 这位年轻运动员展现出巨大的潜力。
words.en: If you say that someone or something has potential, you mean that they have the necessary abilities or qualities to become successful or useful in the future.

words.tr: adj. 冒犯的；令人不快的；进攻性的；
words.ex: His offensive words made her cry.
words.ex_cn: 他冒犯的话让她哭了。
words.en: If you describe someone's language or behavior as offensive, you mean that it is rude or insulting.

words.tr:
n. 外星人；外国人；外侨；
adj. 外国的；陌生的；相异的；
words.ex: The boy saw an alien in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在森林里看到了一个外星人。
words.en: An alien is someone who is not a citizen of the country in which they live, or a creature from outer space.

words.tr: adj. 怀疑的；令人怀疑的；
words.ex: The police felt suspicious about the man's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 警察对这个人的行为感到怀疑。
